เฉดสีรุ้งเหล่านี้เปลี่ยนแปลงและหักเหไปตามแสง ราวกับสัตว์ร้ายที่ซ่อนตัวอยู่ในห้วงลึกของมหาสมุทร ทั้งงดงาม อันตราย และชวนให้ลุ่มหลง
target:
The dress worn by Cantarella the Bane is awash in flowing, vibrant colors.
These iridescent hues change and refract, shifting with the light, like a deadly creature lurking deep in the ocean, beautiful, dangerous, and hypnotic.

source: ชุดที่ Lucilla สวมใส่ในชีวิตประจำวัน ผสมผสานความสง่างามเข้ากับความเรียบง่ายคล่องตัวได้อย่างลงตัว ทั้งยังสะท้อนถึงปณิธานในการใช้ชีวิตของเธอที่ว่า... กิริยาสื่อถึงความสง่างาม และรสนิยมนั้นมาจากภายใน
target: Lucilla's daywear balances elegance with simplicity, embodying her personal philosophy—real elegance stems from demeanor, while true style comes from deep within.

source:
ชุดที่ Lucy สวมใส่เป็นประจำ ทั้งน้ำหนักเบา มีเอกลักษณ์ และมีความเป็นสตรีท ชุดนี้ตอบโจทย์ทุกความต้องการในการปฏิบัติภารกิจ
ในเมื่อเป็นเช่นนั้น ก็ไม่มีความจำเป็นที่จะต้องเปลี่ยนมัน
target:
Lucy's everyday outfit. Lightweight, stylish, and street-ready—it checks every box for a netrunner on a gig.
Since it works for the job, she sees no reason to bother changing.

source:
ชุดที่ Rebecca สวมใส่เป็นประจำ นอกจากชุดชั้นในปกติแล้ว เธอก็สวมแค่เสื้อคลุมเพียงตัวเดียวเท่านั้น
"การเปิดเผยผิวในพื้นที่กว้างจะช่วยให้ไซเบอร์แวร์ระบายความร้อนได้ดีขึ้นนะ" — Rebecca ใช้เหตุผลนี้เป็นข้ออ้าง แอบรูดซิปเสื้อคลุมของเธอลงมาอีกนิด
target:
Rebecca's everyday threads. Aside from her usual undies, she’s pretty much just rocking an oversized jacket.
"Showin’ some skin helps the chrome vent heat better," she claims, using that as a convenient excuse to tug her zipper down just a little further.

source: ชุดที่ Yinlin สั่งตัดจากร้านกี่เพ้าที่เธอชื่นชอบ หรูหรา โอ่อ่า... คำเหล่านี้ไม่ค่อยจะใช้กับสายลับ แต่กลับสะท้อนตัวตนที่แท้จริงของ Yinlin ภายใต้หน้ากากนับไม่ถ้วนของเธอ
target: An outfit Yinlin commissioned her favorite qipao shop to make. Flamboyant, extravagant... Adjectives that aren't normally used on secret agents describe the real Yinlin behind her many masks.

source: ชุดที่งดงามราวกับภาพวาดทิวทัศน์อันวิจิตร ราวกับเชิญชวนให้ถ่ายทอดลงบนผ้าใบอีกครั้ง
target: A picturesque outfit that puts one in mind of an exquisite painting. Landscapes abound, waiting to be recaptured on canvas.

source: ชุดที่นักวิจัยของสถาบันหัวซวีสวมใส่ เปลวไฟภายในมังกรแดงยังคงลุกโชนดังเดิม แต่เขาก็ได้พบหลักยึดสิ่งหนึ่งที่เขาตั้งใจจะอุทิศชีวิตให้
target: An outfit worn by Huaxu Academy researchers. The fire inside the Red Dragon is burning as fierce as ever, but he has found his anchor, something he intends to devote his life to.

source: ชุดที่สัมผัสนุ่มดั่งขนนก แต่ก็แข็งแรงทนทาน ขนนกพลิ้วไหวราวกับสายลม ปักษาโบยบินสู่ฟ้าตามกระแสพลังพร้อมบรรเลงบทเพลง
target: An outfit soft to the touch, like feathers, but also highly durable. Feathers fill with wind, lifting the lark to the sky, and a song sounds as it flies.

source: ชุดที่เบาบางแต่สง่างามทุกท่วงท่า สายลมโชยพัดผ่าน Ciaccona ขณะที่เธอเล่นดนตรี และเนื้อผ้าที่พลิ้วไหวก็เป็นเหมือนเครื่องดนตรีคอยประสาน
target: An attire that is light but lacks no elegance. A gentle breeze passes by as Ciaccona plays her instrument, the rustling of the fabric of her clothes sometimes becomes the accompaniment.

source: ชุดที่เรียบง่ายแต่ใช้งานได้จริง ออกแบบมาสำหรับการเดินทางไกลโดยเฉพาะ ผู้แสวงหาความจริงจะไม่หวั่นไหวต่ออุปสรรคใดๆ ที่ขวางหน้า
target: A simple, practical outfit, specifically designed for use on long-distance expeditions. A truth seeker is drawn to the truth, undeterred by any obstacle in their path.

source: ชุดธรรมดาที่สะท้อนเอกลักษณ์ของเมิ่งโจว แต่งเติมด้วยของประดับระยิบระยับและระฆังจิ้งจกเสียงใส ให้สาวน้อยอิสระสดใสเปล่งประกายอย่างมีชีวิตชีวา
target: An outfit in Mengzhou's style, adorned with shiny trinkets and jingling bells—perfect for its carefree, spirited wearer.

source: ชุดนักเรียนหลักสูตรเตรียมความพร้อมของสถาบันสตาร์ทอร์ช ได้รับการ "ปรับแต่งเล็กน้อย" เพื่อให้เข้ากับสไตล์ที่ Lynae ชอบ ลดแรงต้านลมขณะขับขี่ให้มากที่สุด ใช่แล้ว สีที่เปื้อนอยู่ก็เป็นส่วนสำคัญของการออกแบบด้วย!
target: The Startorch Academy's prep uniform, "slightly modified" for Lynae's taste, tailored to minimize drag at high speeds. And yes, the splashes of color are a crucial part of the design!

source: ชุดน้ำหนักเบาแต่แข็งแรงทนทานที่ Lumi ผู้นำทางของลอลโล่โลจิสติกส์สวมใส่ ผ่านการเดินทางส่งของที่ยากลำบากมานับครั้งไม่ถ้วน
target: A lightweight yet sturdy outfit, worn by Lollo Logistics Navigator Lumi. It has survived many arduous deliveries.

source: ชุดปกติของผู้พเนจร นี่คือสิ่งที่เธอสวมใส่ตั้งแต่เริ่มต้นการเดินทาง และจะเป็นสิ่งที่เธอสวมใส่ต่อไปตลอดการเดินทางนี้
target: Rover's usual outfit. This is what she wore at the beginning of her journey and what she will be wearing for the rest of it.

source: ชุดประจำของผู้พเนจร นี่คือชุดที่เขาสวมตั้งแต่เริ่มต้นการเดินทาง และจะเป็นชุดที่เขาสวมใส่ตลอดการเดินทาง
target: Rover's usual outfit. This is what he wore at the beginning of his journey and what he will be wearing for the rest of it.

source: ชุดประจำของผู้พเนจร นี่คือชุดที่เธอสวมตั้งแต่เริ่มต้นการเดินทาง และจะเป็นชุดที่เธอสวมใส่ตลอดการเดินทาง
target: Rover's usual outfit. This is what she wore at the beginning of her journey and what she will be wearing for the rest of it.

source: ชุดประจำวันของสถาบันสหพันธ์สเปซเทรค หญิงสาวตัวน้อยสวมชุดนี้ท่องไปในโลกแห่งข้อมูล โลหะ และกระแสที่ผันแปร ท่ามกลางความสงัดของหมู่ดาว การสำรวจของมนุษย์ยังคงดำเนินต่อไปอย่างไม่สิ้นสุด
target:
A standard uniform of the Spacetrek Collective Research Institute.
Wearing it, the petite girl moves among data streams, machinery, and shifting currents. Beneath the silent gaze of the stars, humanity's drive to explore never ceases.

source: ชุดประดับด้วยริบบิ้นโปร่งแสงสองเส้นที่เรืองแสงสีฟ้าอ่อนเข้ากับผิวพรรณของ Jinhsi อย่างลงตัวภาระของทั้งจินโจววางอยู่บนบ่าของเธอ แต่เธอก็แบกรับไว้ด้วยความสง่างามและเกียรติยศ
target: An outfit adorned with two diaphanous ribbons that seem to glow a faint blue, a perfect match for Jinhsi's complexion. The weight of the whole Jinzhou has been put on her shoulders, but she bears it with grace and dignity.

source: ชุดพิเศษที่ Roccia สวมใส่เวลาแสดงตลกด้นสด ตัดเย็บจากเศษวัสดุต่างๆ ตกแต่งด้วยของเล็กๆ น้อยๆ ที่ Roccia สะสมไว้ด้วยความรัก
target: A unique outfit Roccia wears when doing improv comedy. Made out of various scraps, this product of love is decorated with odds and ends that Roccia has accumulated.

source: ชุดสูทสั่งตัดที่สวมทับชุดมวยรัดรูป เน้นย้ำเรือนร่างที่แข็งแรงและทรงพลังของ Yuanwu
target: A tailored suit over a form-fitting set of boxing attire, accentuating Yuanwu's long-limbed and powerful physique.

source: ชุดเดรสวันพีซดีไซน์โดดเด่น สีแดงคือสีประจำตัวของ Carlotta เธอสวมมันแม้ตอนปฏิบัติภารกิจลับ ท่ามกลางรัตติกาลที่การพรางกายเป็นสิ่งสำคัญ แต่เธอกลับไม่ยอมทำตามขนบธรรมเนียมและเป็นผู้นำเทรนด์
target: A boldly designed one-piece dress. Red is Carlotta's color. She wears it even on secret missions, in the dead of night, when stealth is crucial. She is a nonconformist and trendsetter.

source: ชุดเบาสบายที่ Chixia จ้าวลมกรดแห่งจินโจวโปรดปราน เหมาะสำหรับเธอที่ต้องรีบรุดไปหาผู้ที่เอ่ยนามเรียกเธอเสมอ
target: A featherlight outfit favored by Jinzhou Speedster Chixia, perfect for her need to rush to the side of whoever calls out her name.

source: ชุดเบาสบายสีหม่นของ Sanhua เมื่อเป็นยามอยู่ที่ว่าการเมือง เธอเคลื่อนไหวอย่างว่องไว ถือดาบคมกริบในมือ และพร้อมปกป้องสันติภาพอยู่เสมอ
target: A somber-colored lightweight outfit, worn by the City Hall guard Sanhua. She moves swiftly, a sharp blade in hand, ready to defend peace.

source: ชุดเรียบง่าย
ชุดเรียบร้อยที่ Lingyang สวมใส่ตอนแสดงเชิดสิงโต ประดับลวดลายดั้งเดิมที่เชื่อกันว่านำโชคดีมาให้ ลวดลายนั้นสดใสราวกับพลังวัยเยาว์ของ Lingyang
target: A neat outfit Lingyang wears when performing liondances. It is adorned with a traditional pattern said to bring good luck, and the pattern is as vibrant as Lingyang's youthful energy.

source: ช่วงเวลาเงียบงัน
ช่วงเวลาเรโซแนนซ์
ซัพพอร์ตและฮีลเลอร์
ซิงโครนิสต์ของ Exostrider แห่งวิทยาลัยราเบลล์ บัดนี้เธอได้กลายเป็นภูตดิจิทัลที่ขับขานบทเพลงแผ่วเบาท่ามกลางหมู่ดารา
target: Once an Exostrider Synchronist of Rabelle College, she is now a digital ghost who sings quietly amongst stars.

source: ซิมโฟนีแห่งห้วงเหนือสังสาร
ณ กึ่งกลางระหว่างข้างขึ้นและข้างแรม ความว่างเปล่าและโลกหล้า เส้นไหมและทองคำ... ดวงจันทร์ร่อนเร่ผ่านทุกฤดูกาล มีเพียงเธอผู้เดียว ที่อยู่เหนือเกณฑ์ใดทั้งปวง
target: Between wax and wane, void and world, satin and gold... The moon wanders, slipping through every season. Only she defies all measures.

These iridescent hues change and refract, shifting with the light, like a deadly creature lurking deep in the ocean, beautiful, dangerous, and hypnotic.

source:
「毒藥」坎特蕾拉身著的衣裙上流動著絢麗的色彩。
這些幻彩隨著光線不同，會折射出不同的色澤。就像蟄伏深海的劇毒之物，美麗、危險、迷幻。
target:
The dress worn by Cantarella the Bane is awash in flowing, vibrant colors.
These iridescent hues change and refract, shifting with the light, like a deadly creature lurking deep in the ocean, beautiful, dangerous, and hypnotic.

source: 「讓每一位來到這裡的顧客都能露出笑容，就是本店的宗旨！」
target: "Bringing a smile to every passenger is our cafe's top priority!"

source:
「静かな夜に、月の光を摘み取った者がいた。
運命を信じぬ彼女は——それでもその祝福を、あなたに語りかけたいと願っていた」
target:
"On a hushed night, someone drew down the moonlights.
She does not believe in fate, yet she smiles as she reveals its blessings for you."

source: 「누군가가 고요한 밤하늘에서 달빛을 땄다. 결코 운명을 경외하지 않는 그녀였지만, 달빛의 축복을 당신에게 들려주고 싶어 한다」
target:
"On a hushed night, someone drew down the moonlights.
She does not believe in fate, yet she smiles as she reveals its blessings for you."

source:
「독약」 칸타렐라가 입은 드레스에는 화려한 색채가 띄고 있다.
드레스 위의 색채는 빛에 따라, 서로 다른 빛깔을 반사해 낼 수 있다. 마치 독성이 강한 심해 생물처럼, 아름답고 위험하며 환상적이다
target:
The dress worn by Cantarella the Bane is awash in flowing, vibrant colors.
These iridescent hues change and refract, shifting with the light, like a deadly creature lurking deep in the ocean, beautiful, dangerous, and hypnotic.

source: 「방문하는 모든 손님이 미소를 지을 수 있도록! 이건 우리 카페의 신념이거든!」
target: "Bringing a smile to every passenger is our cafe's top priority!"

source: 「비명 리콘: 무음 위기」 기간 한정 이벤트에서 획득
「비명 리콘: 솔라리스 솔져」 기간 한정 이벤트에서 획득

「평범한 학생일 뿐이에요.」
조용히 자기소개를 하는 그녀의 눈동자에서 알록달록한 빛이 은은히 뿜어져 나왔다. 그렇게 모든 사건과 사물의 구조를 선명히 파악한 그녀는, 눈을 가늘게 뜨고는 그 속에서 생명을 이끄는 현을 찾아냈다
target:
"Just an ordinary student."

Calmly, she introduces herself, a faint iridescent shimmer flickering in her eyes. Again, the structures of the world reveal themselves in her vision. Narrowing her eyes, she singles out the very thread that tugs at life itself.

source:
いつも今州の街で走り回っている今州の若き巡尉。
尽きることなく滾る情熱を弾丸に変え、その手にある銃から叩き込む。
target:
Chixia is a spirited young Jinzhou Patroller who lights up the streets of Jinzhou. She's always ready to be the hero someone needs.
She fuses such passion into the bullets that blast out of her fingertips.

source: いつも優しい微笑みを見せてくれる。加えて、植物の知識量なら、誰にも負けない。彼女はその知識を存分に活かし、植物に秘める命という奇跡を守ろうとする。
target: With an extensive knowledge of botany, Verina is always solicitous, always smiling, and always wishing for every flower to be blessed with the miracle of life.

source:
お喋りで風変わりな古物鑑定士。
エンタメとしてユーモアに鑑定結果を伝える。古物を大切にしてくれる人達のために、露店を構えている。
target:
A voluble and whimsical antique appraiser.
Known for creating limericks on the spot, she presents her appraisals with flair and precision. She sets up a stall on the street, ensuring antiques find their way to those who truly cherish them.

source: お楽しみにしてください
お茶香る、悠々自適な潮旅

この装い纏いて、重州から明庭へ、明庭から六州へ。
来たりし道は、連峰幾重。
去りゆく道は、天涯孤独。
target: From Chongzhou to Mingting, across the six states of Huanglong, his worn attire bears the weight of travel, tracing the swordsman's solitary path.

source: ご注文、もう決まったかな？ぜひこの素敵なひとときを、満喫してくださいね。
target: Can I get you something? Please, order whatever you like, and savor the sweetness of this moment.

source: さびしい宿に灯る蒼き光

その両目は光を失い、ただ独り行く剣客。以前は明庭鎮撫司に勤めており、官職は千戸であった。
若き日は、数多の仇敵と刃を交え、長じては、法の下に人を捕らえた。されど、濡れ衣を着せられ獄に下り、今や、天涯孤独の風来坊となった。
target:
Former senior agent of Mingting's Internal Security Agency.

Though enmity filled his younger days, loyalty defined his later years. However, scapegoated for a murder, he is now but a blind swordsman wandering the world alone.

source: より効率的に敵の共振度を削れる
target: Reduces the Vibration Strength of targets more effectively

source: アンコ　デフォルト

アヴェラルド金庫防衛課に所属し、称号「最優秀社員」の長年の保持者。
仕事の余暇のために、たくさんの計画やプランを用意している……が、まずは定時退勤をどう実現するかについて考えよう。
target:
A member of Averardo Vault's security team and holder of "Best Employee" for longer than she cares to count.

She has made plenty of plans for her free time, but for now, her biggest mission is simple: clocking out on time.

source: アールト　デフォルト
イベント「月が照らす道」で獲得
イベント「踏破！パラドックス領域」で獲得可能
エイメス　デフォルト

エイメスが自ら描いた一枚の絵。
「良い旅を！」
target:
A picture painted by Aemeath.
"So... journey well!"

カルテジアが聖女として冠を授けられた際に纏っていた衣装。冠に絡んだ茨と共に歩み抜いた嵐。彼女は、”救済”という名の責務を一瞬たりとも忘れたことはなかった。
target: The dress Cartethyia wore during her coronation as the Blessed Maiden. These thorns accompanied her through storms of solitude, and they serve to engrave the responsibilities of "salvation" deep into her heart.

カルロッタ　デフォルト
カレイに指令を出して、埃に埋もれたギミックを解除しよう
target: Ask Currie to help you activate the dormant mechanisms.

ガルブレーナ　デフォルト
キャプテンが海に出る時身につけているコスチューム。劇団の衣装のデザインは全て、これをベースに仕立てられている。船上から見える海と空の色、その全てを彼はラグーナへと持ち帰りたいのだ。
target: A costume the captain wears on his grand voyages. Its design inspires the garments of the Troupe of Fools. It captures the hues of sea and sky, bringing their grandeur back to Ragunna.

source: キャラクター獲得後解放
キャラクター衣装獲得後解放
target: Obtain the Resonator Outfit to unlock

source: コンダクターである自分のために用意した特別な礼服。幾重もの花びらが舞い落ちては、此岸と彼岸の境に咲き誇る。紅い一輪が水面に口づけし、叶わぬ願いの余韻は今もなお、彼女の耳元で静かに囁き続けている。
target: Designed by the Conductor herself, this exclusive gown features cascading petals that bloom between this world and the beyond. As the red lycoris kisses the water, the melody of unfulfilled wishes still echoes in her ears.

source: ザンニー　スペシャル
ザンニー　デフォルト
シグリカ　デフォルト
シャコンヌ　デフォルト
ショアキーパー　デフォルト
ショアキーパー。ブラックショアの守護者。彼女の説明は、それが全て。絆や希望、あらゆる感情は、あなたと出会ってから芽生えた。
target:
The Shorekeeper, guardian of the Black Shores—this title alone once defined her.
But desires, bonds, and emotions… She only began to understand these things after meeting you.

source: スキルレベルアップ素材
スタイルに合わせて仕立てられたオーダースーツ。白と黒の配色がシンプルで上品。仕事に追われていても、身だしなみを整えるのは最低限のマナーだ。
target: A custom-made uniform, primarily of simple black and white color schemes. No matter how heavy the work load, one must maintain an impeccable appearance.

source: スタートーチ学園、ラベル学部所属。かつて「エクソストライダー」の適格者だった彼女は、 今や星の海で軽やかに歌う、デジタルゴーストとなった。
target: Once an Exostrider Synchronist of Rabelle College, she is now a digital ghost who sings quietly amongst stars.

source: スタートーチ学園の学園長、ルシラー。地に足のついた理想主義者である彼女は、教え子たちが空へと挑む姿を静かに見守り続けている。
target: Lucilla, President of Startorch Academy and idealist with both feet on the ground. She holds quiet vigil over her students as they rise to challenge the very sky.

source:
スタートーチ学園の学生シグリカ、ロイルーンの共鳴者。
皆の期待に応えるため、立派なソル・スウォーンになるべく、常に全力を尽くしている。
target:
Sigrika, a student of Startorch Academy and a Resonator of Royan Runes.
Determined to live up to others' expectations and become a true Solsworn, she devotes herself fully to every challenge.

source: スタートーチ学園プレパラトリー・プログラムの制服を、リンネー流に「軽くアレンジ」したもの。すべてはバイクで走る際のスピードを引き出すため、風の抵抗を最小限に抑えることを意図している。もちろん、あちこちについたカラフルなペイントも、計算されたデザインの一部だ！
target: The Startorch Academy's prep uniform, "slightly modified" for Lynae's taste, tailored to minimize drag at high speeds. And yes, the splashes of color are a crucial part of the design!

source: スタートーチ学園プレパラトリー・プログラムの学生。主張の激しい外見通り、溢れんばかりのバイタリティとパワーで満ちている。
target: A Startorch Academy prep student whose head-turning, electric style hides an inner focus as explosive as a coiled spring.

source: ストラクチュアル・リコンストラクション
スペーストレック・コレクティブ
スペーストレック研究院に日常的な服装。華奢な少女はそれをまとい、データや鋼鉄、時間の流れの間を行き来する。星々は沈黙したままであるも、人々は探究の歩みを止めることはない。
target:
A standard uniform of the Spacetrek Collective Research Institute.
Wearing it, the petite girl moves among data streams, machinery, and shifting currents. Beneath the silent gaze of the stars, humanity's drive to explore never ceases.

source:
スペーストレック研究院のエンジニアにして、スタートーチ学園エクソストライダー工学部で教授を務めている。
心に満天の星空を描き、造り物の足で大地を踏みしめる。
target:
Mornye, a Spacetrek Collective Research Institute engineer and a Department of Exostrider Engineering professor at Startorch Academy.
Each step on her prosthetic legs carries her toward the stars of her dreams.

source:
セブン・ヒルズのグラディエーター。人々の注目を集めるスター選手。
真っ直ぐで情熱的な彼女は、一匹狼のような野生の本能を持つ。そこに純粋な闘技があるのなら、戦場で燃え尽きようとも後悔はない。
target:
A Gladiator of Septimont, a radiant star of the arena.
Fiery and straightforward, Lupa lives like a wild lone wolf. As long as she can savor the adrenaline rush of battle, she doesn't mind if that same fire ends up consuming her whole.

source: セブン・ヒルズのグラディエーターたちが着用する闘技用の衣装。ルパの戦闘スタイルに合わせて幾度も手直しが施されている。彼女はこの衣装をまとい、孤独だった日々を駆け抜け、闘技場を沸かせる歓声をその手で勝ち取った。
target: This custom Septimont Gladiator suit has evolved through many revisions to match Lupa's unique fighting style. It bears silent witness to her countless solitary days and nights, as well as the thunderous cheers that followed her every triumph.

source:
セブン・ヒルズの現総督。不滅の太陽にして、無敵の旗。
彼女は来た、見た、そして勝った。
その刃を高く掲げ、次に来る挑戦者……あるいは、避けられぬ運命を、ただ待ち構える。
target:
Ephor of Septimont. The undying sun eternally ablaze, and a banner under which defeat does not exist.
She comes. She sees. She conquers.
With blade held high, she awaits the next challenger or the fate that claims it cannot be defied.

source:
セブン・ヒルズ至堅の鉄より鍛えられた、栄光の戦鎧。
血と砂を浴びてもなお、その輝きは増し、表面は烈日の光を受ければ、あらゆる宝石を凌ぐ閃光を放つ。それこそが、この鎧に相応しい飾りである。
target: Armor that gleams over blood and sand, forged from the strongest iron in all of Septimont. When the blazing sun strikes its surface, its brilliance reveals splendor's true face.

source: ゼノドメイン・ハッキング
ソラリス各地を狩猟して回る「デビルハンター」であり、その冷酷な見た目と非情ぶりから、人々は彼女を「永炎の悪魔」と呼んでいる。今はブラックショアの協力者として、世界各地で活躍している。
target: Cold and decisive, she is the "Discord Slayer" who hunts across Solaris and the same "Fiend of Ever-burning Flame" spoken of in whispers. Now, she serves as a Black Shores Consultant, active across the world.

ダーニャの視点に切り替わります

ナイトシティから来たエッジランナー。チームでは主にネットランナーとしてハッキングを担当。
胸の奥底にしまった秘密を隠すべく、他人と深く関わることを避けている。最も近しい仲間たちでさえ、彼女の過去についてはほとんど知らない。
target:
An Edgerunner from the Night City. The Netrunner of her crew.
With a heavy debt in her heart, she deliberately keeps a distance from people. Even those who are closest to her know little of her past.

source: ノクターン・ガーデン
ハックダメージを与えることができる
フィサリアファミリー
フィービー　デフォルト
フィービーの記憶には、いつも一抹の青が留まっている。それは幼い頃、枕元の物語から羽ばたいてきた小鳥の色、彷徨う彼女に居場所を与えてくれた侍祭たちのローブの色、あるいは――悪夢から彼女を優しく抱き上げてくれた、あのそよ風の色。
target: Phoebe's memories are always tinged with a shade of blue. The bird that soared from her childhood bedtime stories, the robes of the Acolytes who offered her sanctuary, and the gentle breeze that carried her out of her darkest dreams.

source: フローヴァ　デフォルト

ブブ物流でナビゲーターを務める物流チームの班長。
越州の山村出身。太陽のように人々を照らす誠実で親切な少女。
target:
Navigator at Lollo Logistics and leader of a transport squad.
Born in a mountain village in Yuezhou, Lumi's sincere and caring nature brings warmth to everyone around her.

source: ブラックショアと繋がり、いつもニコニコして霧のように掴みどころがない情報屋。対価さえ払えばどんな情報でも提供してくれる、という噂も。
target:
Aalto is an enigmatic Information Broker, known for his elusive nature and welcoming smile. Underneath the facade, he is closely affiliated with the Black Shores.
Rumor has it he'll provide any information at the right price.

source: ブラックショアのみんながアンコのために特別にカスタマイズした服。黒メェ、白メェ、集合！1、2……3！よーし、みんな揃ったね！さあ、宝探しの時間だ！
target: A custom-made outfit gifted to Encore by her fellow Black Shores members. Cosmos and Cloudy, reporting for duty! One, two... three! Great, everyone is here. Let the treasure hunt begin!

source:
ブラックショアの協力者で、二色の羊のおもちゃと一緒に行動する少女。
飴と童話と幻想で幸せな物語を作ることが夢。
target: A girl accompanied by one black and one white Wooly. Encore, consultant from the Black Shores, dreams of creating happy stories with candies, fairy tales, and her imagination.

プリズマティック・カラー
メインストーリー無冠者無音占用中

モーニエ　デフォルト
ユニークなコメディア・デラルテの公演用コスチューム。ロココが日頃から拾い集めたものと、ペロが長年かけて集めたコレクションを組み合わせて、丁寧に縫い上げている。
target: A unique outfit Roccia wears when doing improv comedy. Made out of various scraps, this product of love is decorated with odds and ends that Roccia has accumulated.

source: ユーノ　デフォルト
リトルビッグスーツケース
リナシータの吟遊詩人――シャコンヌ。神のため、そして平凡な人々のため歌う女性。 旅の途中で物語を記録し、それを歌い継ぐ彼女は、物語の主人公や、物語の聞き手に深く共感し、彼らと共に泣いたり笑ったりする。
target:
A wandering bard from Rinascita, Ciaccona. She sings not only for the Divinity, but also for the common folk.
She records stories along her journeys, turning them into songs that evoke laughter, emotion, and tears in both the storytellers and the audience.

source: リナシータ各地を旅する放浪騎士。かつては聖女でもあり、神の器でもあり、「風と潮の王」でもあった。長年フルールドリスと呼ばれていたが、今は自由を手に入れた、ただの騎士に過ぎない。
target: Cartethyia, the wandering knight who travels across Rinascita. Formerly known as the Blessed Maiden, the vessel of Divinity, and the Queen of Gale and Tide, she went by the name Fleurdelys. Now, she is simply a free and unfettered wandering knight.

source: リューク・ヘルセン　デフォルト
リンネー　スペシャル
リンネー　デフォルト
ルシラー　デフォルト
ルーシー　デフォルト

ルーシーと同じエッジランナーでありながら、そのスタイルはまるで正反対。
愛用のショットガンであらゆるトラブルを吹き飛ばす、自由奔放な気分屋。
target:
An Edgerunner like Lucy, though completely different in her M.O.
A whimsical fireball who's always ready to raze out your troubles with her shotgun.

source: ルーシーの普段着。スタイリッシュかつ軽量で実用的――ネットランナーにとって必要な条件をすべて満たしているため、仕事のときもわざわざ着替えることはしない。
target:
Lucy's everyday outfit. Lightweight, stylish, and street-ready—it checks every box for a netrunner on a gig.
Since it works for the job, she sees no reason to bother changing.

source: レベッカ　デフォルト

レベッカ愛用のストリートウェア。下着の上からダボついたジャケットを羽織るだけの、彼女らしい着こなし。
「肌を出してる方が、クロームの熱を逃がしやすいんだよ」――そんな言い訳を口にしながら、レベッカはファスナーをさらに下げてみせた。
target:
Rebecca's everyday threads. Aside from her usual undies, she’s pretty much just rocking an oversized jacket.
"Showin’ some skin helps the chrome vent heat better," she claims, using that as a convenient excuse to tug her zipper down just a little further.

source: ロココ　デフォルト
ヴェリーナ　デフォルト
ヴェリーナが調査に出掛ける時に着る服。新たな蕾の言葉を、彼女はすべて心に刻んでいる。
target: An outfit Verina wears when doing fieldwork. Every word from each unfurling bud, Verina engraves in her heart.

source: 一定範囲内の敵の行動速度を低下させる
target: Slows down targets within a certain range

source: 一定範囲内の敵を特定の位置まで牽引できる
target: Pulls targets within range towards a specific position

source: 一生只追求武术极致的道士，实力莫测、抱朴守一的风仪拳传人。拥有将周围环境气韵化为内在，形成涤净力场的能力。
target: Jianxin, a Taoist monk and successor of Fengyiquan, has dedicated her life to mastering the ultimate martial art. With the power to harness and transform environmental Chi, she can create protective barriers that purify both body and mind.

source:
七丘的现任总督。长照不灭的烈阳，所向披靡的旗帜。
她来，她见，她征服。
她高擎锋刃，等待着下一个挑战者，抑或是无可抗拒的命运。
target:
Ephor of Septimont. The undying sun eternally ablaze, and a banner under which defeat does not exist.
She comes. She sees. She conquers.
With blade held high, she awaits the next challenger or the fate that claims it cannot be defied.

source:
七丘的現任總督。長照不滅的烈陽，所向披靡的旗幟。
她來，她見，她征服。

Ephor of Septimont. The undying sun eternally ablaze, and a banner under which defeat does not exist.

source:
七丘的角斗士，万众瞩目的明星选手。
热情率直，如孤狼般具有野性的少女。若是能够一直享受竞技纯粹的快乐，露帕无畏在这赛场燃烧殆尽。
target:
A Gladiator of Septimont, a radiant star of the arena.
Fiery and straightforward, Lupa lives like a wild lone wolf. As long as she can savor the adrenaline rush of battle, she doesn't mind if that same fire ends up consuming her whole.

七丘的角鬥士，萬眾矚目的明星選手。
熱情率直，如孤狼般具有野性的少女。若是能夠一直享受競技純粹的快樂，露帕無畏在這賽場燃燒殆盡。
target:
A Gladiator of Septimont, a radiant star of the arena.
Fiery and straightforward, Lupa lives like a wild lone wolf. As long as she can savor the adrenaline rush of battle, she doesn't mind if that same fire ends up consuming her whole.

情绪反复无常的她乐意用手中的霰弹枪帮你解决任何麻烦。
target:
An Edgerunner like Lucy, though completely different in her M.O.

source: 丹心照夜破重云，长剑清风扫恶尘。行遍人间明与暗，旧影随风赴新晨。
target: A loyal heart pierces the night, shattering the clouds. Long sword sweeps away the filth of evil like a clear wind. Having walked through both the light and shadow of this life, the shadows of the past dissolve into the winds of a new dawn.

今令尹今汐，万丈天光被她化作点点辉芒，温柔地照亮人们的愿望。
命运向她指明神灵的方向，但她脚下的道路，仍然通向人类的未来。
target:
Jinhsi, Magistrate of Jinzhou, gently brightens the hopes of her people, like rays of winter sunlight.

今州华胥研究院首席研究员，最年轻的全科学者。

Principal Investigator at Jinzhou Huaxu Academy, and the Academy's youngest multi-disciplinary scientist.
A gentle soul with a sharp mind, whose relentless passion for Automata Mechanics always translates into constructive findings and insights.

An Edgerunner from the Night City. The Netrunner of her crew.

source:
愚人剧团副手、万能道具师兼即兴喜剧演员洛可可将剧团打理得井井有条。

target:
Assistant, prop master, and improv comedian, Roccia is always there to make sure the Troupe of Fools is at the ready.

A wandering bard from Rinascita, Ciaccona. She sings not only for the Divinity, but also for the common folk.

Chixia is a spirited young Jinzhou Patroller who lights up the streets of Jinzhou. She's always ready to be the hero someone needs.

금주 영윤 금희, 하늘의 빛이 여러 갈래의 빛으로 퍼지며 사람들의 소망을 밝혀준다.
운명은 그녀에게 신의 방향을 제시하지만, 그녀의 발걸음은 늘 인간의 미래를 향해 나아간다

Jinhsi, Magistrate of Jinzhou, gently brightens the hopes of her people, like rays of winter sunlight.

target:
Principal Investigator at Jinzhou Huaxu Academy, and the Academy's youngest multi-disciplinary scientist.
A gentle soul with a sharp mind, whose relentless passion for Automata Mechanics always translates into constructive findings and insights.

source: 금주의 윙스맨은 항상 가벼운 차림으로 길거리에 수없이 전해 오는 「치샤」의 부름에 곧장 달려간다
target: A featherlight outfit favored by Jinzhou Speedster Chixia, perfect for her need to rush to the side of whoever calls out her name.

도관에서 나눠준 수행 용 복장.
감심은 입을 때마다 항상 사부의 가르침을 되새긴다. 한 걸음만 움직여도 흔적없이 사라진다. 숨을 쉬는 사이에 시간이 가는 줄도 모른다

target: A unique outfit Roccia wears when doing improv comedy. Made out of various scraps, this product of love is decorated with odds and ends that Roccia has accumulated.

source:
뛰어난 말주변을 가진 재간둥이 보물 감정사.
즉석에서 시를 지을 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 보물 감정 결론을 매우 흥미진진하면서도 조리 있게 말할 수 있는 특기가 있다. 골동품을 아끼는 사람들에게 골동품이 흘러들어가도록 길거리에서 가게를 열어 보물들을 감정하고 있다

A voluble and whimsical antique appraiser.
Known for creating limericks on the spot, she presents her appraisals with flair and precision. She sets up a stall on the street, ensuring antiques find their way to those who truly cherish them.

source:
레베카가 평소에 입는 복장. 속옷 위에 오버사이즈 재킷만 걸치고 다닌다.
「피부가 많이 드러나야 사이버웨어 열기가 더 잘 빠져나간다고!」—— 레베카는 핑계를 대며, 슬그머니 재킷 지퍼를 조금 더 아래로 내린다

Rebecca's everyday threads. Aside from her usual undies, she’s pretty much just rocking an oversized jacket.
"Showin’ some skin helps the chrome vent heat better," she claims, using that as a convenient excuse to tug her zipper down just a little further.

source:
루시가 평소에 입는 복장. 가볍고 개성이 넘치는 스트릿 패션 의상은 넷러너 의뢰 수행에 필요한 모든 조건을 갖추고 있다.
일하기 적합하기에 굳이 갈아입지 않아도 상관없다고 생각한다
target:
Lucy's everyday outfit. Lightweight, stylish, and street-ready—it checks every box for a netrunner on a gig.
Since it works for the job, she sees no reason to bother changing.

source:
루시와 같은 엣지러너이지만, 하는 행동은 전혀 다르다.
당신의 고민쯤은 손에 든 샷건으로 시원하게 날려버릴 준비가 된, 예측 불가의 불꽃같은 존재
target:
An Edgerunner like Lucy, though completely different in her M.O.
A whimsical fireball who's always ready to raze out your troubles with her shotgun.

source: 루실라의 일상 복장. 우아하면서도 간결한 디자인으로 그녀의 인생 철학을 고스란히 담아낸다. —— 우아함은 행동에서 피어나며, 품격은 내면에서 깊이 우러나온다
target: Lucilla's daywear balances elegance with simplicity, embodying her personal philosophy—real elegance stems from demeanor, while true style comes from deep within.

source: 리나시타를 여행하는 떠돌이 기사 카르티시아. 그녀는 과거 성녀였고, 신의 그릇이자 바람과 조수를 지배한 자였다. 한때 플뢰르 드 리스로 불리기도 했지만, 지금은 그저 자유로운 떠돌이 기사일 뿐이다
target: Cartethyia, the wandering knight who travels across Rinascita. Formerly known as the Blessed Maiden, the vessel of Divinity, and the Queen of Gale and Tide, she went by the name Fleurdelys. Now, she is simply a free and unfettered wandering knight.

source:
리나시타의 음유시인, 샤콘. 그녀는 신과 평범한 인간 모두를 위해 노래한다.
그녀는 여행을 통해 이야기를 기록하고 노래하며 이야기의 주인공, 그리고 관객과 함께 웃고 감동의 눈물을 흘린다
target:
A wandering bard from Rinascita, Ciaccona. She sings not only for the Divinity, but also for the common folk.
She records stories along her journeys, turning them into songs that evoke laughter, emotion, and tears in both the storytellers and the audience.

source: 먹물로 염색되어, 천에 그림을 그려진 옷. 아름다운 풍경은 어디에나 존재하니, 그림을 그리고 싶은 마음도 자연스레 생긴다
target: A picturesque outfit that puts one in mind of an exquisite painting. Landscapes abound, waiting to be recaptured on canvas.
Main Quest Crownless Tacet Field is unavailable

source: 목표에게 조화 파동 피해를 입힐 수 있다
target: Deals Tune Rupture DMG to targets

source: 목표에게 해킹 피해를 입힐 수 있다
몽주의 독특한 개성이 담긴 소박한 옷에 반짝이는 장식과 경쾌한 방울이 더해져, 자유로운 소녀의 모습을 더욱 빛나고 생기롭게 물들인다
target: An outfit in Mengzhou's style, adorned with shiny trinkets and jingling bells—perfect for its carefree, spirited wearer.

source:
무무물류의 내비게이터이자 운송팀의 팀장.
월주 산속 마을 출신이며, 성실하고 열정적이다. 작은 태양처럼 타인을 밝게 비춰주는 순박한 소녀이다
target:
Navigator at Lollo Logistics and leader of a transport squad.
Born in a mountain village in Yuezhou, Lumi's sincere and caring nature brings warmth to everyone around her.

source: 물결무늬처럼 얇은 천이 옅은 파란색을 띠며, 순수하고 어여쁜 하얀 소녀를 부드럽게 감싼다. 역류의 조수처럼 그녀를 해안으로 돌려보내지만, 그녀는 담담하게 금주를 지켜낸다
target: An outfit adorned with two diaphanous ribbons that seem to glow a faint blue, a perfect match for Jinhsi's complexion. The weight of the whole Jinzhou has been put on her shoulders, but she bears it with grace and dignity.

source: 뭐 좀 드릴까요? 마음껏 주문하시고, 지금 이 순간을 만끽하기를
target: Can I get you something? Please, order whatever you like, and savor the sweetness of this moment.

source:
바람의 숨결과 더 깊이 이어진 후, 「소리의 수호자」로서의 복장.
종달새가 어린 깃을 털어내고 바람을 가르며 높이 날아오른다. 앞으로도 그녀는 늘 그래왔듯, 자신이 믿는 모든 것을 향해 거침없이 날갯짓할 것이다
target:
Her attire as the "Votary of the Voice," worn after deepening her bond with the Streams.
The bird has shed its down and rides the wind toward the heights. From here on, too, she will stride forward, toward everything she believes in.
Lampylumen Myriad Tacet Field is unavailable

source:
방랑자가 자주 입는 복장.
이건 방랑의 시작점이자 끝까지 함께 할 증표이기도 한다
target: Rover's usual outfit. This is what he wore at the beginning of his journey and what he will be wearing for the rest of it.

source:
방랑자가 자주 입는 복장.
이건 방랑의 시작점이자 끝까지 함께 할 증표이기도 한다
target: Rover's usual outfit. This is what she wore at the beginning of her journey and what she will be wearing for the rest of it.

source:
벨리나가 과학 탐사 시 자주 입는 복장.
그녀는 모든 싹이 트기 시작하는 꽃술의 이야기를 다 마음에 담아두었다고 한다
target: An outfit Verina wears when doing fieldwork. Every word from each unfurling bud, Verina engraves in her heart.

source: 벨리나는 항상 다정하고, 늘 미소짓고 있으며, 식물 지식에 능하다. 그녀는 모든 꽃들이 생명의 기적을 가질 수 있길 바란다
target: With an extensive knowledge of botany, Verina is always solicitous, always smiling, and always wishing for every flower to be blessed with the miracle of life.

source: 변정 호위의 제복. 가벼우면서도 복잡한 디자인 없이 소소하다. 짙은 빛깔로 무간(無間)에 넘나들면서 날카로운 칼을 휘두른다. 이게 바로 그녀가 이 밝은 세상을 지키기 위한 결심이다
target: A somber-colored lightweight outfit, worn by the City Hall guard Sanhua. She moves swiftly, a sharp blade in hand, ready to defend peace.
Utilizes Fusion Burst for combat advantage

source: 블랙&화이트를 포인트로 한 맞춤 제작 오피스룩. 업무 스트레스가 아무리 심하더라도, 외모는 반드시 가꿔야 한다
target: A custom-made uniform, primarily of simple black and white color schemes. No matter how heavy the work load, one must maintain an impeccable appearance.

source: 비교적 강한 협동 공격 능력 보유

사자춤 공연단의 깔끔하고 편한 공연 복장.
무늬 하나하나가 사자 갈기처럼 역동적이고, 마치 변하지 않는 소년의 초심과도 같다
target: A neat outfit Lingyang wears when performing liondances. It is adorned with a traditional pattern said to bring good luck, and the pattern is as vibrant as Lingyang's youthful energy.
Utilizes Glacio Chafe for combat advantage

source: 선약 방송국을 통해 획득할 수 있습니다
선장의 항해와 함께하는 무대 복장이다. 극단의 복장 스타일은 다 이 콘셉트로 디자인된다. 브렌트는 배 위에서만 볼 수 있는 바다와 하늘의 색깔을 모든 관객에게 전해 주고 싶어 한다
target: A costume the captain wears on his grand voyages. Its design inspires the garments of the Troupe of Fools. It captures the hues of sea and sky, bringing their grandeur back to Ragunna.

source:
설지는 화서연구원의 연구원으로 주로 울림 성태학을 연구한다.
이루지 못한 소원이 또다른 형태로 남아 그녀를 지키고, 그녀에게 「치유「의 어빌리티를 부여했으며, 그녀가 평생 연구해야 하는 과제로 남았다
target:
Baizhi is a researcher in Remnant Ecoacoustics.
Baizhi's once unfulfilled wish has now manifested as her loyal companion. The Remnant Creature You'tan is her source of healing powers, and a lifelong research focus.

source: 세련되면서도 기능성이 있는 복장. 멀리 탐사를 하기 위해 특별히 제작되었다. 모험가는 어려움을 두려워하지 않고, 진실을 갈망하는 마음을 가지며 가벼운 걸음으로 길을 떠나기로 결심하니 극복할 수 없는 고난은 결코 존재하지 않는다
target: A simple, practical outfit, specifically designed for use on long-distance expeditions. A truth seeker is drawn to the truth, undeterred by any obstacle in their path.
Gild the years with gold, and crown you with the stars.

source: 스타토치 아카데미 라벨 학부의 엑소스트라이더 적격자, 지금은 별바다를 떠돌며 노래하는 전자 유령이다
target: Once an Exostrider Synchronist of Rabelle College, she is now a digital ghost who sings quietly amongst stars.

source:
스타토치 아카데미의 교장 루실라. 현실적인 이상주의자.
묵묵히 학생들의 뒤를 지키며, 그들이 하늘에 도전하는 모습을 바라본다
target: Lucilla, President of Startorch Academy and idealist with both feet on the ground. She holds quiet vigil over her students as they rise to challenge the very sky.

source: 스타토치 아카데미의 예과 교복. 린네의 스타일로 「아주 조금」 꾸며 바이크를 탈 때 바람의 저항을 최대한 줄일 수 있다. 맞아, 색깔이 묻어있는 것도 디자인의 중요한 부분이란걸!
target: The Startorch Academy's prep uniform, "slightly modified" for Lynae's taste, tailored to minimize drag at high speeds. And yes, the splashes of color are a crucial part of the design!

source: 스타토치 아카데미의 예과 학생. 개성 넘치는 외모 속에 넘치는 활력과 힘을 가지고 있다
target: A Startorch Academy prep student whose head-turning, electric style hides an inner focus as explosive as a coiled spring.

source:
스타토치 아카데미의 학생 시그리카, 로야 룬의 공명자.
모두의 기대에 부응하고 자격을 갖춘 솔스원이 되기 위해 언제나 최선을 다한다
target:
Sigrika, a student of Startorch Academy and a Resonator of Royan Runes.
Determined to live up to others' expectations and become a true Solsworn, she devotes herself fully to every challenge.

source:
스페이스트렉 콜렉티브 연구소의 엔지니어 모니에는 스타토치 아카데미 엑소스트라이더 공학부에서 교수로 재직 중이다.
그녀는 인공 다리로 대지에 발을 디디고, 마음속에는 찬란한 뭇별을 품고 있다
target:
Mornye, a Spacetrek Collective Research Institute engineer and a Department of Exostrider Engineering professor at Startorch Academy.
Each step on her prosthetic legs carries her toward the stars of her dreams.

source: 스페이스트렉 콜렉티브 연구소의 일상 복장. 몸집이 아담한 소녀는 이 옷을 입고 데이터, 강철, 격류 사이를 오간다. 뭇 별들은 침묵을 지키고, 사람의 탐구는 영원히 멈추지 않는다
target:
A standard uniform of the Spacetrek Collective Research Institute.
Wearing it, the petite girl moves among data streams, machinery, and shifting currents. Beneath the silent gaze of the stars, humanity's drive to explore never ceases.

source:
아베라르도 금고 방위과 직원이자, 모범 직원 최다 선정자.
자신의 여가 시간을 위해 수많은 계획을 짜 두었지만, 일이 이 지경이 된 이상, 일단 정시에 퇴근할 방법부터 찾아야 한다
target:
A member of Averardo Vault's security team and holder of "Best Employee" for longer than she cares to count.

She has made plenty of plans for her free time, but for now, her biggest mission is simple: clocking out on time.

source: 아시노하라에서 온 타오르는 벚꽃의 무녀. 현재 유일무이한 특별 대책반 멤버로 라하이 로이에 머물고 있다
target: Hailing from Ashinohara, the Miko of Flaming Sakura now remains in Lahai-Roi as the last and only member of the Special Response Force.

source:
알토는 마치 변덕스러운 안개처럼 종잡을 수 없다.
평소에 그는 웃는 얼굴로 손님을 맞이하는 정보 상인이지만, 사실 검은 해안과 긴밀히 연결되어 있다.
후하게 값을 지불하여 그와 거래하면 원하는 정보를 살 수 있다고 한다
target:
Aalto is an enigmatic Information Broker, known for his elusive nature and welcoming smile. Underneath the facade, he is closely affiliated with the Black Shores.
Rumor has it he'll provide any information at the right price.
Utilizes Havoc Bane for combat advantage

source: 앙코의 곁에는 항상 그늘이와 구름이, 두 개의 양 인형이 함께 한다. 검은 해안의 멤버인 앙코는 캔디, 동화, 환상을 잔뜩 넣어 해피엔딩 이야기를 만드는 걸 좋아한다
target: A girl accompanied by one black and one white Wooly. Encore, consultant from the Black Shores, dreams of creating happy stories with candies, fairy tales, and her imagination.

source:
야귀의 일원으로, 바람의 메시지를 감지할 수 있다.
자신이 인정한 아름다운 것들을 지키기 위해, 그녀는 자신의 부드러움을 칼날로 바꿀 각오가 되어있다
target:
A member of the Midnight Rangers who can sense messages in the wind.
In order to protect the goodness that he believes in, he has the sense to turn his gentleness into a sharp blade.

source:
야귀의 일원으로, 바람의 메시지를 감지할 수 있다.
자신이 인정한 아름다운 것들을 지키기 위해, 그녀는 자신의 부드러움을 칼날로 바꿀 각오가 되어있다
target:
A member of the Midnight Rangers who can sense messages in the wind.
In order to protect the goodness that he recognizes, he is also aware of the need to turn tenderness into sharp edges.

source: 야귀의 일원으로, 흐르는 바람을 감지하고 바람의 소리를 듣는 공명 어빌리티를 가지고 있다. 어떤 어려운 상황이라도 얼굴에는 항상 미소가 띄워져 있다. 자신이 인정한 아름다운 것들을 지키기 위해, 그녀는 자신의 부드러움을 칼날로 바꿀 각오가 되어있다
target: Yangyang is an Outrider of the Midnight Rangers. Once sheltered, now a fighter. She soars with the wind to protect others, like a skylark in flight.

source:
양양은 「야귀」에 속한 임시 조사원이다.
가족의 울타리에서 온실의 화초처럼 자라던 소녀는 종달새가 바람을 뚫고 자신의 길을 향해 날아가듯, 이제는 자신의 힘으로 남을 지키려 노력하고 있다
target:
Yangyang is an Outrider of the Midnight Rangers.
Once sheltered, now a fighter. She soars with the wind to protect others, like a skylark in flight.

source:
에이메스가 직접 그린 그림.
「즐거운 여행 되시길!」
target:
A picture painted by Aemeath.
"So... journey well!"

source:
영윤의 호위로 얼음처럼 차갑다.
그녀의 눈에는 세상 모든 것이 기괴한 모양으로 뒤틀려 있으며, 정상적이고 순수한 진실을 유지하는 사람은 극소수에 불과하다
target:
The Dragon Lord's close guard is as clear and cold as ice and snow.
In her eyes, everything in the world twists and turns into strange shapes, with only a few maintaining a normal and pure reality.

source: 옛날에 방랑자가 스타토치 아카데미에서 입었던 복장. 흑백의 조화 위에 금색으로 수놓아, 흐릿한 과거를 소중한 추억으로 장식하고 다가올 미래를 손에 닿을 듯 선명하게 그려냈다
target: Rover's uniform from a past life at Startorch Academy. The black-and-white motif, accented with gold stripes, weaves past and future together, ensuring that what has happened is remembered and what is yet to come feels within reach.

source: 오류 발생, 문의 사항이 있으실 경우 고객센터로 연락주시기 바랍니다
target: An error occurred. Please contact our Customer Service for assistance.

source: 오류 발생, 문의 사항이 있으실 경우 고객센터로 연락주시기 바랍니다
target: Error detected. If you have any questions, please contact Customer Service.

source: 오류 발생. 문의 사항이 있으실 경우 고객센터로 연락주시기 바랍니다
오류 발생. 문의 사항이 있으실 경우 고객센터로 연락주시기 바랍니다

옥패는 티 없이 반짝이고 깨끗하다. 붉은 빛을 자주 접하다 보니 점점 빨갛게 변해 간다... 소설에서는 이렇게 쓰여 있다
target: Jade, clear and pure, assumes rosy hues after long exposure to crimson dye... at least that's what they say in the novels.

source:
우인 극단 조수, 만능 소품 담당자와 즉흥 연극배우를 겸하고 있는 로코코는 극단을 질서정연하게 잘 운영한다.
로코코가 항상 가지고 다니는, 온 세상을 담은 듯한 진기한 상자는 그녀에 의해 만들어진 또 다른 세상 같기도 하다
target:
Assistant, prop master, and improv comedian, Roccia is always there to make sure the Troupe of Fools is at the ready.

The Magic Box she carries appears to hold the world, or perhaps she had recreated a world inside the box.

source: 음림은 선천형 공명자이자 보안서의 훌륭한 순찰관이었다. 그러나 지금은 한 사건으로 순찰관 신분을 말소하고 은밀한 곳에서 홀로 숨어 있는 죄악을 조사하고 있다
target: Yinlin is a skilled Patroller and powerful Natural Resonator. After being suspended from her duties at the Public Security Bureau, she must now pursue hidden evils in secrecy.

source:
음림이 본인 가장 애용하는 치파오 가게에서 주문 제작한 복장.
화려하고, 눈에 띈다... 이 모든 게 다 잠입 수사관과는 반대되지만, 「가면」으로 가려진 뒤에 있는 진실된 그녀를 만들었다
target: An outfit Yinlin commissioned her favorite qipao shop to make. Flamboyant, extravagant... Adjectives that aren't normally used on secret agents describe the real Yinlin behind her many masks.

source: 의뢰를 받아 생계를 유지하는 화가이다. 걱정이 많고 예민하며, 표현이 서투르다. 자신의 생각과 느낌을 그림에 오롯이 담아내곤 한다. 그녀의 붓끝을 통해 그려진 만물은 생동감이 넘쳐 마치 그림 밖으로 금방이라도 뛰쳐나올 것만 같다
target: An artist for hire trying to make a living. Reserved and timid, she is not good with words but speaks volumes through her art, where her creations come to life with impossible authenticity.

source: 의사는 침착하게 행동하면서도, 소리 없이 날카로운 기세를 품고 있다. 구원과 단죄의 맹세 사이에서, 그는 한 치의 흔들림 없이 완벽한 균형을 지키며 걸어간다
target: A healer of quiet precision, with a hidden edge in every quiet gesture. Salvation and judgment are the two oaths he bears, and he walks the razor's edge between them without ever losing balance.

source: 이 차림새로 중주부터 명정을, 또 명정부터 6개의 주(州)를 넘나들었으니, 오는 길은 첩첩산중, 가는 길은 혈혈단신이도다
target: From Chongzhou to Mingting, across the six states of Huanglong, his worn attire bears the weight of travel, tracing the swordsman's solitary path.

source:
이번 라군나와 검은 해안의 합동 시뮬레이션이 성공적으로 막을 내린 것을 기념한다.
이번 시뮬레이션에서 뛰어난 활약을 보여준 전사들에게 바친다
target:
A commemoration of the successful joint exercise between Ragunna and the Black Shores.
Dedicated to the warriors who distinguished themselves during the drill.

source:
이번 스페이스트렉 콜렉티브와 검은 해안의 합동 훈련이 성공적으로 막을 내린 것을 기념한다.
훈련에서 뛰어난 활약을 보여준 모든 교직원과 학생들에게 바친다
target:
A commemoration of the successful joint exercise between the Spacetrek Collective and the Black Shores.
Dedicated to the faculty and students who shone in the drill.

source: 일곱 언덕 검투사의 경기 코스튬이다. 루파의 경기 스타일에 맞추기 위해 여러 차례 수정을 거쳤다. 그녀와 함께 외로운 낮과 밤을 보냈으며, 그녀와 함께 경기장의 박수갈채도 받아왔다
target: This custom Septimont Gladiator suit has evolved through many revisions to match Lupa's unique fighting style. It bears silent witness to her countless solitary days and nights, as well as the thunderous cheers that followed her every triumph.

source:
일곱 언덕의 검투사, 주목받는 스타 선수.
열정적이고 직설적이며 외로운 늑대처럼 야성적인 소녀. 대결의 순수한 즐거움을 계속 누릴 수 있다면, 루파는 이 경기장에서 타올라 사라지게 되더라도 두려워하지 않을 것이다
target:
A Gladiator of Septimont, a radiant star of the arena.
Fiery and straightforward, Lupa lives like a wild lone wolf. As long as she can savor the adrenaline rush of battle, she doesn't mind if that same fire ends up consuming her whole.

source:
일곱 언덕의 현임 장관. 영원히 비추는 태양이자 영원히 휘날리는 깃발이다.
그녀가 왔고, 보았고, 정복하였다.
예리한 칼날을 높이든 그녀는 다음 도전자, 그리고 저항할 수 없는 운명을 기다린다
target:
Ephor of Septimont. The undying sun eternally ablaze, and a banner under which defeat does not exist.
She comes. She sees. She conquers.
With blade held high, she awaits the next challenger or the fate that claims it cannot be defied.

source: 일정 범위 내에서 목표의 행동 속도 낮추기 가능
target: Slows down targets within a certain range

source: 일정 범위 내의 목표를 특정 위치로 끌어당기기 가능
target: Pulls targets within range towards a specific position

source: 자신의 조화도 파괴 증폭에 근거하여 목표에게 입히는 최종 피해가 증가된다
target: Gains total DMG increase from Tune Break Boost

source:
전 명정 진무사의 천호장, 두 눈을 잃은 외로운 검객.
어릴 적엔 그의 원한을 산 자들이 많았고, 장성한 후엔 사람을 쫓는 일을 업으로 삼았다. 하지만 생각지도 못하게 누명을 쓰고 옥에 갇히게 되었다. 지금 그는 지천을 떠도는 방랑의 길 위에 서 있다
target:
Former senior agent of Mingting's Internal Security Agency.

Though enmity filled his younger days, loyalty defined his later years. However, scapegoated for a murder, he is now but a blind swordsman wandering the world alone.
Utilizes Electro Flare for combat advantage

source:
정의를 품은 황룡 야귀의 리더. 번개처럼 맹렬하며, 바람처럼 신속하다.
바람으로 청룡을 창조하는 어빌리티를 가지고 있으며, 만부부당의 무력을 가지고 있다
target: Jiyan, leader of the Midnight Rangers, acts with swift and resolute righteousness. He possesses the formidable ability to conjure a powerful Qingloong from the winds, making him invincible on the battlefield.

source:
정체불명의 공명자, 모든 소리를 흡수할 수 있는 힘을 가지고 있다.
기억을 되찾기 위해 여행을 떠난다
target: A mysterious Resonator with the power to absorb all sounds. Currently journeying to find their lost memories.

source: 주문 제작한 정장 슈트 속에 딱 달라붙는 권술 연습용 복장. 깔끔한 핏으로 연무의 길쭉하고 건장함을 더욱 더 드러내게 한다
target: A tailored suit over a form-fitting set of boxing attire, accentuating Yuanwu's long-limbed and powerful physique.
Inferno Rider Tacet Field is unavailable

source: 지휘자가 자신을 위해 디자인한 전용 드레스. 고개를 숙인 풍성한 꽃잎이 피안과 현실 사이에 만개해 있다. 핏빛 꽃이 수면에 입 맞추고, 끝나지 않은 염원의 잔음이 그녀의 귓가에 영원히 맴돈다
target: Designed by the Conductor herself, this exclusive gown features cascading petals that bloom between this world and the beyond. As the red lycoris kisses the water, the melody of unfulfilled wishes still echoes in her ears.

source: 진심은 밤을 비추어 구름을 가르고, 검의 숨결은 악을 물리친다. 속세의 밝음과 어둠 사이를 거닐고, 옛 그림자는 바람을 따라 새벽으로 향한다
target: A loyal heart pierces the night, shattering the clouds. Long sword sweeps away the filth of evil like a clear wind. Having walked through both the light and shadow of this life, the shadows of the past dissolve into the winds of a new dawn.

source: 짧은 시간에 비교적 높은 협주 효율 보유
차가운 인상과 아무렇지 않게 살육을 저지르는 무자비함을 가진, 솔라리스 곳곳을 유랑하며 사냥하는 「데빌 헌터」. 사람들에게는 「영원한 불꽃의 악마」라고도 불린다. 현재 그녀는 검은 해안의 초청 멤버로서 세계 각지에서 활약하고 있다
target: Cold and decisive, she is the "Discord Slayer" who hunts across Solaris and the same "Fiend of Ever-burning Flame" spoken of in whispers. Now, she serves as a Black Shores Consultant, active across the world.

source:
착용자에 딱 맞게 재단한 과학 탐사 세트 복장.
행동 편의를 최대한 강조하는 디자인이다. 세상에서 진리를 찾는 것이 어렵지만, 그 진리를 닿은 사람이라면 수많은 노력과 근기가 필요하다
target: A well-fitted uniform that provides great freedom of movement, perfect for fieldwork. Truths are elusive, accessible only to the most indefatigable seekers.

source: 천공의 일원으로, 열정을 탄약으로 전환할 수 있으며, 그녀의 탄약은 그녀의 열정처럼 무한하다. 정의의 파트너로 자칭하며, 항상 활기찬 모습으로 금주의 거리를 누빈다. 도움이 필요한 사람이 있는 곳이라면 어디든 달려간다
target: Chixia is a spirited young Patroller who lights up the streets of Jinzhou. She's always ready to be the hero someone needs.

source: 충만과 결핍, 거짓과 진실, 얇은 비단과 황금... 그 사이에서 떠도는 달이 모든 계절을 적신다. 그녀는 헤아릴 수 없는, 단 하나의 존재다
target: Between wax and wane, void and world, satin and gold... The moon wanders, slipping through every season. Only she defies all measures.

source: 카레를 지휘하여, 먼지로 뒤덮인 기관을 열게 하세요
target: Ask Currie to help you activate the dormant mechanisms.

source: 카르티시아가 성녀의 신분으로 대관을 치를 때의 코스튬이다. 그 가시덤불들은 그녀와 함께 폭우 속을 걸어 다녔고, 그녀는 「구원」이라는 책임을 마음속에 새길 것이다
target: The dress Cartethyia wore during her coronation as the Blessed Maiden. These thorns accompanied her through storms of solitude, and they serve to engrave the responsibilities of "salvation" deep into her heart.
Obtain the Resonator Outfit to unlock
Bell-Borne Geochelone Tacet Field is unavailable

source:
파수인, 검은 해안의 수호자. 이 정도의 설명만으로도 충분할 것 같다.
갈망, 속박, 감정... 직책 외의 모든 것은 당신과의 만남 후에 보다 가득 차게 되었다
target:
The Shorekeeper, guardian of the Black Shores—this title alone once defined her.
But desires, bonds, and emotions… She only began to understand these things after meeting you.

source: 파수인은 인간의 모습으로 드러나 자신의 생명을 「깨워주는」 누군가에 응답한다. 이건 당신이 그녀에게 처음으로 전해준 것이자 그녀의 기점에 관한 전부이기도 한다... 당신은 항상 그녀에게 수많은 「신생(新生)」을 주었다
target: She manifested in human-like form in response to the one who awakened her, marking the beginning you bestowed upon her. It was the starting point of a new life. It was not the first time, nor would it be the last.

source: 파티 내 특정 캐릭터의 강공격 피해 부스트 가능
target: Provides Heavy Attack DMG Amplification for a specific Resonator in the team

source: 파티 내 특정 캐릭터의 경직 저항력 증가 가능
target: Boosts the interruption resistance of a specific Resonator in the team

target: Restores the Resonance Energy of a specific Resonator in the team

target: Boosts the Off-Tune Buildup Rate for a specific Resonator in the team

target: Provides Echo Skill DMG Amplification for a specific Resonator in the team

target: Provides Fusion DMG Amplification for a specific Resonator in the team

target: Provides Glacio DMG Amplification for a specific Resonator in the team

target: Provides Electro DMG Amplification for a specific Resonator in the team

target: Provides additional Tune Break Boost for a specific Resonator in the team

target: Provides DMG Amplification for a specific Resonator in the team

target: Provides Coordinated Attack DMG Amplification for a specific Resonator in the team

source: 파티 내 특정 캐릭터의 회절 피해 부스트 가능
target: Provides Spectro DMG Amplification for a specific Resonator in the team

source: 페비의 기억 속에는 언제나 한 가닥의 푸른색이 있다. 어릴 적 잠자기 전 들었던 이야기 속에서 날개를 펼친 작은 새는 그녀에게 사는 곳을 마련해 준 성직자들의 옷을 갖다주었다거나, 또는—— 그녀를 악몽 속에서 일으켜 준 부드러운 바람...
target: Phoebe's memories are always tinged with a shade of blue. The bird that soared from her childhood bedtime stories, the robes of the Acolytes who offered her sanctuary, and the gentle breeze that carried her out of her darkest dreams.

source: 평생 무술의 극치만을 추구했던 도사로 실력을 가늠할 수 없는 자신의 본분을 다하는 풍의권의 전승자다. 주변 환경의 기운을 내면에 담아 바람장의 정화를 형성하는 능력을 가지고 있다
target: Jianxin, a Taoist monk and successor of Fengyiquan, has dedicated her life to mastering the ultimate martial art. With the power to harness and transform environmental Chi, she can create protective barriers that purify both body and mind.
Utilizes Aero Erosion for combat advantage

source: 피와 모래 위에서 빛나는 영광의 갑옷, 일곱 언덕의 단단한 철로 만들어졌다. 태양이 갑옷의 표면을 비추면 눈부신 빛을 내뿜으며, 이 뜨거운 빛이야말로 갑옷에 가장 어울리는 장식이다
target: Armor that gleams over blood and sand, forged from the strongest iron in all of Septimont. When the blazing sun strikes its surface, its brilliance reveals splendor's true face.

source:
협객 단근은 자신의 혈액을 응고시켜 붉은 빛 복수의 칼날을 만든다.
붉은 빛 칼날을 휘두르며, 옳고 그름을 분별하고, 적을 소멸하며, 세상을 유랑한다
target:
With a vengeful blade of condensed blood in hand, Ranger Danjin hunts down thieves and bandits for retribution.
She journeys to distant lands in pursuit of justice.

source:
화서연구원 안전과 연구원이자 흑석 응용 분야 전문가. 평소에 쌓인 감정을 화염으로 응집하는 어빌리티를 가지고 있다.
뜨거운 레드드래곤은 결국 모든 것을 불태워버린 불길 속에서 나타날 것이다
target:
Mortefi, a skilled expert in Applied Tacetite Study and a member of the Academy’s Department of Safety, possesses the unique ability to transform his accumulated frustration into fiery flames.
From a burning wrath that consumes all, the red dragon shall descend.

source:
화서연구원 흔한 과학 연구 실험 복장.
레드 드래곤의 화염은 꺼지지 않지만, 모르테피는 이미 자신만의 추구를 찾았다. 그것 또한 그의 평생 쫓아가고자 하는 목표이기도 하다
target: An outfit worn by Huaxu Academy researchers. The fire inside the Red Dragon is burning as fierce as ever, but he has found his anchor, something he intends to devote his life to.

source:
황룡 경내에서 편하게 활동하기 위해, 카카루가 직접 주문 제작한 황룡 스타일의 작전 복장.
카카루의 요구대로 복잡한 장식을 추가하지 않았고, 가벼우면서도 오래 착용할 수 있는 데다가 탁월한 은신 기능까지 보유하고 있다
target: A Huanglong-style combat uniform custom-made for Calcharo, designed for ease of movement in the region. Lightweight yet durable, it is a no-frills outfit tailored to his needs, with an emphasis on concealment.

source:
황룡 몽주의 도사, 검은 해안의 초청 멤버, 풍수 대가, 커뮤니티 헤비 유저.
활달하고 명랑한 성격으로, 세상을 유람하며, 사주와 점괘로 무엇이든 알아맞힌다
target:
Taoist of Mengzhou, Black Shores Consultant, feng shui master, and veteran forum dweller.
